caveats: Every result equals the documented one. Where the documentation quotes a line it collapses runs of spaces: the benches print 'All tests passed! (# Errors:    0)' and '  Tests: 142   Errors: 30'.
make test/sv/test_example exits with status 2: the documented Verilator build error (FUNCTIMECTL), not a test failure.

Wall times were measured with a warm ccache (every simulator compile was a cache hit), so first builds on a fresh machine take longer; the documented 'about 20 seconds' and 'about 15 seconds' for the first simulator builds (docs/FREERTOS.md:155,229) were therefore not measured.

make freertos-stress (the validate campaign, docs/VERIFICATION.md:77, README.md:91) is recorded separately under results/freertos-validate/; the formal proof (docs/VERIFICATION.md:82) under results/formal/; the trap sweep (docs/VERIFICATION.md:71) under results/trapsweep/.

The template row follows docs/FREERTOS.md section 8 literally: make freertos-new NAME=myapp, then make freertos-compare APP=myapp DEFS=-DTEMPLATE_WITH_IRQ=1 (the copy was removed again before make freertos-list was run).

The size line in the recorded output of minimal, stress, mzba, full and freertos-shell-test is printed only when the command links the program (a new build directory, in the order of the commands, or after removing build/test/freertos/<app>/out.elf); results/check.sh removes that file before each of these commands.
